Candlelight & Bonfire Dining by the Waves

Taste of Ratnagiri

Home-Style Konkani Feasts for the Whole Table

No trip to Ratnagiri is complete without authentic coastal flavors. Our resort kitchen uses freshly grated coconut, organic Ratnagiri kokum, hand-pounded Malvani spices, and morning catch straight from local fishing boats.

🐟 Royal Surmai & Pomfret Thali

Signature

Crispy rawa-fried Kingfish or Pomfret, spicy tisrya (clams) masala, rice bhakri, and chilled pink Solkadhi.

🥟 Hot Ukadiche Modak & Ghavan

100% Pure Veg

Steamed rice-flour modaks stuffed with jaggery-coconut and drizzled with cow's ghee, plus lacy neer-dosa ghavans.

🔥 Live Group Beach Barbecue

Evening Special

Marinated prawns, paneer tikka, smoky corn, and herb potatoes grilled live beside your private family bonfire.

🥭 Alphonso Mango & Cashew Treats

Seasonal

GI-tagged Ratnagiri Hapus aamras, roasted Konkan cashews (Olya Kajuchi Usal), and refreshing kokum-mint coolers.
